name: Reputation Ratchet
description: Reputation-driven convergence to full compliance. Random audits (pi_0=0.20, signal-independent) with strong reputation escalation (epsilon=1.5, no audit-coefficient dynamics). Labs start non-compliant (expected burden ~11M$ << gain ~80M$), but each catch permanently multiplies perceived reputation cost by 2.5x. After ~4-5 catches the expected burden exceeds even the highest-value gain, and labs comply permanently. Full compliance reached in expectation by step 30-40.
